title: 第5章 二十二条大道第6章 弟子们的进步
slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: 送别天元峰主后的林玄，继续开始了参悟大道。
但又是刚闭关没几天，又有人找上了星陨峰。
来者，同样是一位峰主，第八峰主。
这位，同样是王境强者，而且比此前来的第九峰，天元峰主还要强上一些。
而且如果林玄没记错的话，这第八峰……应该是站在圣女李扶风那边的？
也是来拉拢自己的？
什么时候，自己这个境界跌落的“劫境七重”变得如此受欢迎了？
不过，和天元峰主不一样的是，同为王境，但对林玄的态度却截然相反。
在第八峰主身上，林玄并未看到任何蔑视之意。
而且，是带着诚意来的。
“圣女说了，只要你愿意加入，便可得到一枚蕴神丹。”
蕴神丹，五品丹药，虽说是五品，但与修复神魂相关的丹药，都极其珍贵，正好对林玄此前因渡劫失败造成的神魂损伤十分有效。
虽然现在林玄已经不需要了，但可见对方确实也算是有心了。
没有对比就没有伤害，想到此前的那位天元峰主，林玄便是气不打一处来。
看看，这才叫有诚意，这才叫拉拢。
本来，林玄是不想参与李扶风和陆天行之间的斗争的，双方斗个你死我活也好，跟林玄没有任何关系，他只想尽快领悟余下的两条大道，然后突破王境。
谁输谁赢，跟他都没什么关系。
一旦突破王境，天下之大，哪里去不得？
但如今，林玄改变了想法。
“我答应了。”
“不过，这枚丹药，能否换一下？我伤势已恢复，已经用不上这蕴神丹了。”
第八峰主眯着双眼，呵呵一笑：“可以，林峰主想要换成何种丹药？”
“参道丹。”
参道丹？
第八峰主思索片刻。
参道丹，同样是五品丹药，且还要比那蕴神丹更珍贵一些，主要用于辅助参悟大道，一直是那些劫境九重圆满，正尝试感悟大道，寻求突破王境之人的香饽饽。
这位星陨峰主，伤势刚恢复，便是立即开始为将来再次冲击王境而做准备了啊！
不过，他却不怎么看好。
突破王境失败之人，在第二次冲击王境时，难度会比第一次更高，风险更大，以至于，不是所有人，都敢第二次冲击王境的。
往往一些人，在第一次突破失败后，便没有勇气再冲击第二次了，除非是大限将至，临死前打算拼一把。
“此丹如果峰主做不了主，可以回去商议，到时候给我答复即可。”林玄缓缓说道。
“无妨，此丹虽说珍贵，但老夫还是做得了主的，我替圣女答应了。”
半个时辰后，第八峰主满意的离开了星陨峰。
林玄这边，同样十分满意。
参道丹，对如今已经领悟数条大道的林玄而言，作用微乎其微，远远不及林玄身上的那枚九纹大道金丹，但！
参道丹，可以作为投资，赠给苏怜心后触发返利！
大道金丹，便是林玄投资的四品破境丹所得。
仅仅是四品丹药便如此，那么投资五品丹药……
林玄多少有些期待起来。
另一边。
content_en:
After bidding farewell to Master Tianyuan Peak, Lin Xuan continued to study the path of enlightenment.
But just a few days after retreating, someone came to Starfall Peak again.
The person coming is also a peak master, the eighth peak master.
This person is also a king-level expert, and is even stronger than the leader of the Ninth Peak, Tianyuan Peak, who came before.
And if Lin Xuan remembers correctly, this eighth peak...should be on the side of Saint Li Fufeng?
Are you also here to win over yourself?
When did the "Seventh Level of Tribulation Realm" who had fallen into this realm become so popular?
However, what is different from Tianyuan Peak Master is that they are both in the king realm, but their attitude towards Lin Xuan is completely opposite.
Lin Xuan did not see any contempt in the Eighth Peak Master.
And, it comes with sincerity.
"The saint said that as long as you are willing to join, you can get a Shen Yun Dan."
Yun Shen Dan is a fifth-grade elixir. Although it is a fifth-grade elixir, the elixirs related to repairing the soul are extremely precious. It happens to be very effective against the damage to the soul caused by Lin Xuan's previous failure to transcend the tribulation.
Although Lin Xuan no longer needs it, it can be seen that the other party does have intentions.
There is no harm without comparison. Thinking of the previous Tianyuan Peak Master, Lin Xuan became extremely angry.
Look, this is called sincerity, this is called winning over.
Originally, Lin Xuan did not want to participate in the struggle between Li Fufeng and Lu Tianxing. Whether the two sides fought to the death or not, it had nothing to do with Lin Xuan. He just wanted to understand the remaining two avenues as soon as possible and then break through to the king realm.
Who loses or wins has nothing to do with him.
Once you break through to the King Realm, the world is so big, where can you go?
But now, Lin Xuan changed his mind.
"I agreed."
"However, can this pill be replaced? My injury has recovered and I no longer need this pill."
The Eighth Peak Master narrowed his eyes and chuckled: "Okay, what kind of elixir does Peak Master Lin want to change to?"
"Sandao Dan."
Shendao Dan?
The Eighth Peak Master thought for a moment.
The Shen Dao Pill is also a fifth-grade elixir, and is more precious than the Yun Shen Dan. It is mainly used to assist in understanding the Dao. It has always been a favorite for those who have reached the ninth level of the Tribulation Realm and are trying to understand the Dao and seek to break through to the King Realm.
The Lord of Starfall Peak, as soon as he recovered from his injuries, immediately began to prepare for another attack on the King Realm in the future!
However, he was not very optimistic about it.
For those who fail to break through the King Realm, the second time they attack the King Realm will be more difficult and risky than the first time, so that not everyone dares to attack the King Realm a second time.
Often, some people, after their first breakthrough fails, do not have the courage to try again, unless the deadline is approaching and they plan to give it a try before they die.
"If the peak master can't decide on this pill, you can go back and discuss it, and just give me an answer then." Lin Xuan said slowly.
"It doesn't matter. Although this elixir is precious, I still have the final say. I agreed on behalf of the saint."
Half an hour later, the Eighth Peak Master left Starfall Peak with satisfaction.
Lin Xuan was also very satisfied.
The Shen Dao Pill has very little effect on Lin Xuan, who has now understood several great avenues. It is far less effective than the Nine-line Dao Golden Pill on Lin Xuan's body, but!
Shendao Dan can be used as an investment and will trigger a rebate after being given to Su Lianxin!
The Great Dao Golden Pill was obtained from Lin Xuan’s investment in the Fourth-grade Realm-Breaking Pill.
This is only true for fourth-grade elixirs, so investing in fifth-grade elixirs...
Lin Xuan was somewhat looking forward to it.
